Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and miscopied the father's name from the cited source, conflating the father's surname with the mother's. Despite the WebSurfer surfacing a Wikipedia snippet stating “He was son of the Peruvian composer Daniel Alomía Robles and Carmela Godoy,” the Planner concluded the father was “Daniel Alomia Godoy.” This transcription/interpretation error (swapping Robles for Godoy) directly led to the wrong final answer.
